    ok what is the best feature to be on in order to build websites most efficiently and connect me with the proper outside sources

    Quick answer

    • Best feature to enable for building websites efficiently: Plugins (plus Browse with Bing/Web Browsing if available). Plugins let you connect to external tools, APIs, code repos, CMSs, deployment platforms, and more. Web browsing helps you pull up-to-date docs and references.

    Why this helps

    • Plugins unlock integrations with:
      • Code hosting and version control (GitHub/GitLab)
      • Deployment and hosting (Vercel, Netlify)
      • Headless CMSs (Contentful, Strapi, Sanity, Prismic)
      • Automation and data sources (Zapier, Make)
      • Notion, Airtable, Notebooks, and other collaboration tools
    • Web Browsing lets you fetch current docs, guides, and API references (MDN, React/Next.js docs, Tailwind CSS docs, etc.) without leaving the chat.

    How to enable these features (typical paths)

    • Web/ChatGPT (openai.com)
      • Enable: Plugins and Browse with Bing (or Web Browsing) in Settings > Beta features or Settings > Tools.
      • Install relevant plugins from the Plugin Store (examples: GitHub, Zapier, Notion, Airtable, Contentful, Netlify/Vercel).
    • Mobile apps (iOS/Android)
      • Open the app, go to Profile or Settings, look for Subscriptions/Plugins or Beta features to enable Plugins and Browsing if available.

    Note: Availability and exact steps vary by plan and platform. If you don’t see Plugins or Browsing, you may need to upgrade or waitlist for access.

    Recommended external sources and tools to connect with

    • Code hosting and deployment
      • GitHub, GitLab (source control and CI)
      • Vercel, Netlify (hosting and deployments)
    • Headless CMS and data sources
      • Contentful, Strapi, Sanity, Prismic (content APIs)
      • REST APIs for public data (JSONPlaceholder for tests, OpenWeatherMap, REST Countries, etc.)
    • Design and UI docs
      • Tailwind CSS (docs and utility classes)
      • Material UI (docs and components)
      • React/Next.js official docs
      • MDN Web Docs (HTML/CSS/JS fundamentals)
    • Automation and workflows
      • Zapier, Make (Integromat) for connecting APIs without heavy coding
      • Notion or Airtable for lightweight content and data management
    • Performance and accessibility
    • Collaboration and project management
      • Notion, Trello, Jira (depending on your workflow)
    • Accessibility and quality
      • aXe (accessibility tools), Lighthouse (performance/SEO)
    • SEO and analytics
      • Google Lighthouse docs, Google Search Central (SEO best practices)

    Example workflow to build a site efficiently (plug-and-play)

    1. Plan stack and UI: Decide on Next.js + Tailwind (or simple HTML/CSS/JS for small projects).
    2. Scaffold code via ChatGPT: Generate a basic project structure, routes, and components.
    3. Version control: Create a GitHub repo, push code, and set up CI.
    4. Data and CMS: Connect to a headless CMS (e.g., Contentful) or a REST API for content.
    5. Styling and UI: Implement components with Tailwind or a UI library.
    6. Deployment: Deploy to Vercel or Netlify with a single click/CI trigger.
    7. Docs and references: Use Browse with Bing to fetch current docs as you code.
    8. Iterate: Use automation tools (Zapier) to sync data between services or notify you on changes.

    • Tell me your deployment preference (Vercel, Netlify, or other).
    • I’ll suggest a minimal plugin set and a step-by-step setup for your exact platform.

      I want to build websites for companies that do not have them please give me clear breakdown step by step numbered of what i need to do to set this up

      Step-by-step plan to set up a website-building service for companies without sites 🚀

      Below is a clear, numbered roadmap. Each step builds on the previous one. You can adapt the details to your market, budget, and tech comfort level.

      1) Define your niche, value proposition, and scope 🎯

      • Decide target industries (e.g., local service businesses, restaurants, trades, clinics).
      • Define your service scope per client (e.g., 5-page brochure site, contact/lead form, basic SEO, CMS setup).
      • Choose your value proposition (speed, affordability, lead generation focus, accessibility compliance).
      • Create 3 standard package levels (Basic, Growth, Premium) with fixed deliverables and timelines.

      2) Set up the business basics 🏢

      • Choose a business structure (sole proprietorship, LLC, etc.) and register if needed.
      • Open a business bank account and set up accounting.
      • Get simple contracts: Proposal, Statement of Work (SOW), and an NDA as needed.
      • Decide on a pricing model (fixed-price per site + optional maintenance retainer).

      3) Pick your tech stack (start small, scale later) 🧰

      • Options that cover most clients:
        • DIY/fast: Webflow (great for non-developers, responsive sites, quick delivery).
        • WordPress: Flexible, widely supported (Elementor/Gutenberg, theme frameworks).
        • Headless stack (for scalability): Next.js + Tailwind + a CMS (Contentful, Sanity, Strapi) deployed to Vercel/Netlify.
      • Hosting and domains: Netlify or Vercel for static/dynamic sites; WordPress hosts as needed.
      • Security basics: SSL, backups, uptime monitoring (UptimeRobot, Enpoint, etc.).

      4) Create your standard offerings and pricing models 💳

      • Define clear deliverables for each package (pages, forms, CMS, SEO basics, analytics).
      • Add-ons: copywriting, professional photography, local SEO, ongoing content updates, security/backup, speed optimization.
      • Decide on maintenance: monthly retainer or pay-as-you-go after launch.
      • Prepare a simple pricing sheet and a ready-to-send proposal template.

      5) Build your marketing and lead-generation system 🌱

      • Brand identity: name, logo, color palette, and a compelling value statement.
      • Your own website: lead capture (free site audit, discovery call), portfolio, testimonials.
      • Outreach plan: local networking, LinkedIn outreach, email cold outreach with a value-first hook, referrals.
      • Lead magnets: free website audit, 15–30 minute discovery call.
      • Templates: cold email/script, proposal template, onboarding checklist.

      6) Design a repeatable delivery process (your playbook) 🗺️

      • Discovery: client questionnaire to gather business goals, audience, competitors.
      • Information architecture: sitemap and page plan (homepage, about, services, contact, FAQ, blog).
      • Design: wireframes → visual design mockups (brand-aligned).
      • Content: gather or write copy, optimize images.
      • Development: build on chosen stack, integrate CMS, set up forms, accessibility basics.
      • QA & testing: cross-browser, mobile, performance, accessibility.
      • Handoff: client training, CMS basics, handover docs.

      7) Set up project management and collaboration tooling 🧭

      • Choose one tool: Notion or Trello for project boards; Figma for design; GitHub (optional) for code projects.
      • Create templates: project brief, design brief, change request, QA checklist, release notes.
      • Client access: provide a simple client portal or shared folders for assets and approvals.

      8) Establish content, SEO, and accessibility standards 🧩

      • Content plan: define pages, required copy, images, and CTAs.
      • On-page SEO basics: title tags, meta descriptions, headings, alt text, structured data where applicable.
      • Accessibility goals: aim for WCAG 2.1 AA at launch; include keyboard navigation and focus states.
      • Performance targets: speed budget (e.g., 2–3 seconds LCP for most pages).

      9) Create essential templates and assets 📄

      • Discovery questionnaire (professional tone, clear questions).
      • SOW/Proposal templates (scopes, timelines, payment terms).
      • Client onboarding checklist (assets, access, brand guidelines).
      • Design brief and moodboard templates.
      • Release notes and change-request forms.

      10) Build a minimal, scalable MVP workflow (4–6 weeks per site) 🗓️

      • Week 1: Discovery, sitemap, content plan, and design brief.
      • Week 2: Wireframes and visual design concepts; client sign-off.
      • Week 3–4: Development (CMS setup, pages, forms, responsive styling).
      • Week 5: QA, accessibility checks, performance optimizations.
      • Week 6: Deployment, client training, and handoff; publish and monitor.

      11) Launch and client handoff routines 🚀

      • Final review with client: approve live site, CMS access, and training.
      • Provide training guide: how to update pages, posts, and forms.
      • Deliver handoff assets: credentials, hosting/DNS details, backup plan, and maintenance agreement.

      12) Maintenance, support, and analytics integration 🔧

      • Offer ongoing maintenance retainer (security updates, content updates, backups).
      • Set up analytics and conversion tracking (Google Analytics 4, GA4 goals, Webmaster/SEO tools).
      • Schedule periodic performance checks and accessibility audits.

      13) Compliance, security, and risk management 🔒

      • Data privacy: cookies/consent if collecting user data (in line with GDPR/CCPA as applicable).
      • Terms of service and privacy policy for your business and for client sites.
      • Security: keep CMS/plugins up to date, implement backups, and monitor for uptime.

      14) Revenue growth and scaling strategy 📈

      • Build a portfolio of 6–12 strong case studies.
      • Develop a referral program with incentives for clients and partners.
      • Consider subcontracting: hire vetted freelancers for design, copywriting, or front-end work as demand grows.
      • Establish partnerships with hosting providers, CMS platforms, or local business networks.

      15) Quick-start checklist (actionable right now)

      • Decide target niche and create 3 package outlines with deliverables.
      • Pick your core tech stack (e.g., Webflow for speed or WordPress for flexibility).
      • Create a starter website for your own business (portfolio + lead capture).
      • Draft your SOW, Proposal, and onboarding checklist templates.
      • Build a simple client intake form and discovery questionnaire.
      • Set up your project management system with templates.
      • Prepare a 4–6 week delivery timetable and milestone checklist.
      • Create a basic maintenance retainer plan and pricing.
      • List 5 potential outreach channels and draft your first outreach messages.
      • Gather or create sample assets (brand guidelines, stock imagery) to speed up onboarding.

      Quick-start example: two common stacks

      • Option A: Webflow (fast, visual, great for non-developers)
        • Ideal for: small businesses needing a quick, polished site with CMS.
        • Deliverables: ~5–7 pages, form, basic SEO, simple CMS training.
      • Option B: WordPress + Elementor (flexible, scalable)
        • Ideal for: budget-conscious clients who want easy updates.
        • Deliverables: ~5–6 pages, contact forms, SEO basics, CMS training, backups.
      • Optional advanced path: Next.js + Tailwind + a headless CMS (scalable, fast)
        • Ideal for: clients needing performance and custom features.
        • Deliverables: design system, 5–8 pages, CMS integration, deployment pipeline.

      • A 4-week action plan with specific milestones and dates for your situation.
      • Ready-to-send templates (SOW, proposal, onboarding email).
      • A starter tech stack and a minimal, editable project blueprint you can reuse for clients.

      • Your region or language needs for contracts and marketing materials

  <script>
    // Year
    document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

    // Testimonials data (the 15 reviews you supplied)
    const testimonials = [
      { text: "The house looks brand new after the soft wash service. We had years of algae and mildew buildup on the siding, and it all disappeared without any damage. The team was professional, punctual, and extremely thorough.", rating: 5 },
      { text: "I was amazed by the difference. Our driveway had dark stains that I thought would never come out, but the pressure washing restored it completely. Excellent communication and outstanding results.", rating: 5 },
      { text: "We hired them for a soft wash on our roof and exterior walls. Everything was cleaned safely, and the curb appeal improved instantly. Highly recommend for anyone wanting to protect their home.", rating: 5 },
      { text: "The crew arrived on time, explained the process, and delivered fantastic results. Our patio and walkways look brighter than they have in years. Very satisfied with the service.", rating: 5 },
      { text: "Outstanding experience from start to finish. The soft washing removed mold and grime from our siding without any harsh pressure. The house looks fresh and well-maintained again.", rating: 5 },
      { text: "I've used several pressure washing companies over the years, and this was by far the best experience. Attention to detail was impressive, and every surface looked spotless when they finished.", rating: 5 },
      { text: "Our fence was covered in dirt and discoloration, but after the cleaning it looked almost new. Fair pricing, friendly staff, and exceptional workmanship.", rating: 5 },
      { text: "The transformation of our driveway and front walkway was incredible. Years of buildup were removed in a single visit. We received compliments from neighbors immediately afterward.", rating: 5 },
      { text: "They soft washed our entire property before we listed it for sale. The difference in appearance was dramatic, and it definitely improved the home's presentation.", rating: 5 },
      { text: "Very professional company. They carefully cleaned our stucco exterior using a soft wash method and achieved amazing results without causing any damage. We will definitely use them again.", rating: 5 },
      { text: "The pressure washing service exceeded expectations. Oil stains, dirt, and grime were completely removed from our concrete surfaces. Everything looked fresh and clean.", rating: 5 },
      { text: "Excellent customer service and even better results. Our deck had years of buildup, and now it looks revitalized. The crew worked efficiently and left the area spotless.", rating: 5 },
      { text: "We scheduled a roof soft wash and couldn't be happier. The black streaks and algae were eliminated, and the roof looks significantly newer. Great value for the money.", rating: 5 },
      { text: "From the estimate to the completed job, the entire process was smooth and professional. The siding, gutters, and driveway all look fantastic. Highly recommended.", rating: 5 },
      { text: "I was genuinely surprised by how much brighter and cleaner our home looked after the service. The team was courteous, knowledgeable, and clearly took pride in their work.", rating: 5 }
    ];

    // Render testimonials
    const grid = document.getElementById('testimonial-grid');
    testimonials.forEach((t) => {
      const card = document.createElement('article');
      card.className = 'card testimonial';
      card.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Testimonial');
      // Stars
      const stars = document.createElement('div');
      stars.className = 'stars';
      stars.innerHTML = '★★★★★';
      // Text
      const block = document.createElement('blockquote');
      block.textContent = t.text;
      // Author line (fake, since reviews are anonymous)
      const author = document.createElement('div');
      author.className = 'review-author';
      author.textContent = '— Happy Homeowner';
      card.appendChild(stars);
      card.appendChild(block);
      card.appendChild(author);
      grid.appendChild(card);
    });

    // Contact form: simple client-side validation + simulated submission
    const form = document.getElementById('contactForm');
    const status = document.getElementById('formStatus');
    form.addEventListener('submit', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      // Simple validation
      const name = document.getElementById('name').value.trim();
      const email = document.getElementById('email').value.trim();
      if(!name || !email){
        status.textContent = "Please provide your name and a valid email.";
        status.style.display = 'block';
        status.style.color = '#b91c1c';
        return;
      }
      status.style.display = 'block';
      status.style.color = '#0f5132';
      status.textContent = "Thanks! Your inquiry has been received. We'll reach out shortly.";
      // Simulate "submission" and reset after a moment
      setTimeout(() => {
        form.reset();
        status.textContent = "Submitted! We'll be in touch soon.";
      }, 800);
    });
  </script>

          🧭 How to customize

          • Brand name and identity

            • Update the brand text in the header and anywhere else it appears.
            • Change hero copy to reflect your tone (friendly, modern, or local-focused).
            • Swap the hero image URL in the .hero-image div background if you want a different visual.

          • Services

            • Edit the content inside the service cards or add/remove cards in the Services section.
            • Add icons or images for each service as you like.

          • Testimonials

            • The 15 quotes are already wired to render dynamically from a JSON array. If you add more reviews, append them to the testimonials array in the script.

          • Domain and hosting

            • This is a static site. Deploy simply:
              • Netlify: create a new site from Git, push index.html to a repo, connect the repo to Netlify.
              • Vercel: import the repo, deploy.
              • GitHub Pages: push to gh-pages branch or configure as a GitHub Pages site.

          • SEO and accessibility

            • Update meta description to match your services.
            • Add more alt text to images and ensure color contrast remains accessible.

            ✅ Netlify deployment plan for Like Ya Ask Services (Domain: LikeYaAsk-Services.com)

            Fantastic — I’ll layout a complete, production-ready setup to host your site on Netlify with your custom domain. This includes a Netlify-ready index.html (with a Netlify form), the necessary Netlify config, and clear DNS steps.

            • A Netlify-ready, single-page website (static HTML/CSS/JS) that uses Netlify Forms for the contact/audit submissions.
            • A minimal Netlify config to ensure clean deployment and SPA-friendly routing.
            • A dedicated thank-you page for successful form submissions.
            • Clear DNS instructions to point LikeYaAsk-Services.com to Netlify (two options: Netlify DNS or your current registrar).
            • Quick-start steps to deploy on Netlify with your domain.

<!DOCTYPE html>

  <style>

    .gallery img { width:100%; height:150px; object-fit:cover; border-radius:8px; }

            1. netlify.toml (optional but nice for build behavior)
            toml
 
[build]
  publish = "."
  command = ""

[[redirects]]
  from = "/*"
  to = "/index.html"
  status = 200

            If you prefer, you can also omit netlify.toml and rely on the _redirects approach, but this works well for SPA-style hosting.

            🚀 Netlify deployment steps (step-by-step)

            1. Prepare your code
            • Save index.html, thank-you.html, and netlify.toml in a single repo (e.g., on GitHub).
            1. Create the Netlify site
            • Sign in to Netlify.
            • Click “New site from Git” and connect your Git provider (GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket).
            • Select the repository containing the index.html (and netlify.toml).
            1. Configure build/publish settings
            • Build command: leave empty (since this is a static site).
            • Publish directory: “.” (root) or “/” depending on your repo structure.
            • Deploy the site.
            1. Add your custom domain
            • In Netlify, go to Site settings > Domain management > Add custom domain.
            • Enter LikeYaAsk-Services.com.
            • Netlify will verify ownership and provide DNS guidance.
            1. DNS configuration (two options)

            Option A — Use Netlify DNS (recommended for simplicity)

            • Change the domain’s name servers at your domain registrar to Netlify’s DNS servers (Netlify will show you the exact NS records, typically four NS records).
            • Netlify will manage A/CNAME for apex and subdomains automatically.
            • Enable TLS/HTTPS in Netlify (should be on by default).

            Option B — Keep your existing DNS provider

            • Leave your current DNS with your registrar and add records Netlify shows you:
              • For www (subdomain): CNAME to your Netlify app domain (e.g., your-site.netlify.app).
              • For apex root (likeYaAsk-Services.com): use A records to Netlify’s load balancer IPs (Netlify will supply the exact IPs). If your DNS provider supports ALIAS/ANAME, you can use that instead of A records.
            • Enable HTTPS in Netlify (Force HTTPS).
            1. Test and verify
            • Wait for DNS changes to propagate (typically 15–60 minutes, up to 24–48 hours in some cases).
            • Visit LikeYaAsk-Services.com and www.LikeYaAsk-Services.com to verify both resolve to your Netlify site.
            • Submit the contact form to verify Netlify Forms capture (you can view submissions in Netlify if you enable that feature).
            1. Optional improvements
            • Add a favicon and real brand assets (logo, imagery).
            • Swap in real testimonials/images; optionally add a few case studies.
            • Add analytics (e.g., Google Analytics 4) via Netlify or directly in the page.

            ⏱️ Timeline

            • Quick setup: 1–2 hours to push code + configure Netlify.
            • DNS propagation: 15 minutes to 24–48 hours depending on registrar.
            • Full live site with form capture: ready within a few hours after DNS is pointing.

            🗂️ What I need from you to proceed

            • Confirm you want to proceed with the Netlify deployment using:
              • Domain: LikeYaAsk-Services.com
              • Netlify Forms enabled (as shown)
            • If you already have a domain registrar, which one is it? (e.g., GoDaddy, Namecheap, Google Domains, etc.)
            • Do you want me to provide a GitHub-ready repo link you can fork or clone, or would you prefer to paste these files directly into your own repo?
            • Do you want me to include a “www” variant in the branding and DNS setup as a standard practice (recommended)?

            If you’d like, I can generate a ready-to-use GitHub repo (with index.html, thank-you.html, netlify.toml) and a step-by-step domain setup guide tailored to your registrar. Just tell me:

            • Branding vibe (A/B/C from the earlier branding options) or skip branding for now
            • Your registrar (or keep it generic)
            • Whether you want the Netlify DNS option or keep using your current DNS

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <title>Like Ya Ask Services | Exterior Cleaning & Booking</title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <meta name="description" content="We clean exterior surfaces with safe soft wash and pressure washing. Book trusted service slots for front yard, backyard, driveway, and full-house packages." />
  <meta property="og:title" content="Like Ya Ask Services - Exterior Cleaning" />
  <meta property="og:description" content="Soft wash, driveways, decks, and more. Book online with Venmo as the payment option." />
  <meta property="og:type" content="website" />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    :root{
      --bg: #f7f9fb;
      --surface: #ffffff;
      --text: #0f172a;
      --muted: #64748b;
      --primary: #0b5fff;
      --accent: #10b981;
      --shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(15,23,42,.08);
      --card: #ffffff;
    }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto; color: var(--text); background: var(--bg); }
    a { color: var(--primary); text-decoration: none; }
    header { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; }
    .nav { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; max-width:1100px; margin:0 auto; padding:14px 20px; }
    .brand { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; font-weight:700; font-size:18px; }
    .logo { width:28px; height:28px; border-radius:6px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), #4cc9f0); display:inline-block; }
    nav ul { list-style:none; display:flex; gap:16px; margin:0; padding:0; }
    nav a { color:#334155; font-weight:600; font-size:14px; }
    /* Hero & slides */
    .hero { display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr; gap: 28px; align-items:center; max-width:1100px; margin: 28px auto; padding: 0 20px; }
    .hero-copy { padding: 8px 0; }
    .hero h1 { font-size: 2rem; line-height: 1.15; margin: 0 0 8px; }
    .hero p { color: var(--muted); margin: 0 0 14px; font-size: 1.05rem; }
    .cta { display:flex; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
    .btn { padding:12px 18px; border-radius:8px; border:0; cursor:pointer; font-weight:700; }
    .btn-primary { background: var(--primary); color: #fff; }
    .btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--primary); border:2px solid var(--primary); }
    .slideshow { width:100%; height:320px; border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; position:relative; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
    .slide { position:absolute; inset:0; opacity:0; transition: opacity .8s ease-in-out; background-size: cover; background-position:center; }
    .slide.active { opacity:1; }
    .hero-image { width:100%; height:320px; background:url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1505740106533-1b0b73f6f5c0?q=80&w=1400&auto=format&fit=crop') center/cover no-repeat; border-radius:14px; }

    section { padding: 40px 20px; }
    .section-title { font-size: 1.6rem; margin:0 0 10px; }
    .muted { color: var(--muted); }

    /* Deal packaging & slides */
    .carousel { display:flex; overflow:hidden; border-radius:12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); background:#fff; }
    .carousel-track { display:flex; transition: transform .6s ease; }
    .deal-card { min-width: 260px; padding:14px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; }
    .deal-card img { width:100%; height:150px; object-fit:cover; border-radius:8px; margin-bottom:8px; }
    .deal-title { font-weight:700; font-size:14px; margin:6px 0; }
    .deal-desc { color:var(--muted); font-size: 13px; }

    /* Booking sections (each area its own) */
    .area-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(260px, 1fr)); gap: 14px; }
    .card { background: var(--card); border-radius:12px; padding:14px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); border:1px solid #e8eef6; }
    .card h3 { margin:0 0 6px; font-size: 1rem; }
    .row { display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap:12px; }
    label { font-size:12px; font-weight:600; display:block; margin:6px 0 4px; }
    input, select { width:100%; padding:10px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid #d1d5db; }
    .section-subtitle { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--muted); margin-top:6px; }

    /* Booking summary & modal (Venmo) */
    .summary { font-size:.92rem; color:#374151; }
    .modal { display:none; position: fixed; z-index: 60; left:0; top:0; width:100%; height:100%; background: rgba(0,0,0,.5); align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
    .modal-content { width: min(520px, 90%); background:#fff; padding:20px; border-radius:12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
    .close { float:right; border:0; background:transparent; font-size:20px; cursor:pointer; }

    /* Venmo placeholder visuals */
    .venmo { display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:center; padding:12px; border:1px dashed #ddd; border-radius:8px; background:#fff7f0; }
    .venmo-code { width:120px; height:120px; background:#f0f0f0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border-radius:6px; color:#888; font-size:12px; }
    .pay-btn { background:#1e1e1e; color:#fff; padding:10px 14px; border-radius:8px; border:0; cursor:pointer; font-weight:700; }

    /* Gallery / revolving slideshow of all services */
    .gallery { display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap:12px; }
    .gallery img { width:100%; height:150px; object-fit:cover; border-radius:8px; }

    /* Footer */
    footer { text-align:center; color:var(--muted); padding:24px 12px; border-top:1px solid #e2e8f0; margin-top:20px; }

    @media (max-width: 900px){
      .hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .hero-image { height: 260px; }
      .row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <!-- Header -->

  <!-- Hero with revolving slides and slogan -->
  <section id="home" class="hero" aria-label="Hero">

        <!-- Slides: replace URLs with your own images when ready -->
        <div class="slide active" style="background-image:url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1560448204-e02f11a4a3a6?q=80&w=1400&auto=format&fit=crop')"></div>
        <div class="slide" style="background-image:url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1560448203-5e9e8a3f2d63?q=80&w=1400&auto=format&fit=crop')"></div>
        <div class="slide" style="background-image:url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1612820153432-7e9c1f4d7f0e?q=80&w=1400&auto=format&fit=crop')"></div>
        <div class="slide" style="background-image:url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1560185008-2b63e1f4d8e9?q=80&w=1400&auto=format&fit=crop')"></div>
      </div>

      <h1>We clean surfaces, restore curb appeal, and protect your home — safely and thoroughly.</h1>

  <!-- Deals / Deal Packaging Section -->

  <!-- Booking: each area as its own section -->

  <!-- Gallery (revolving slideshow of all services) -->

    <div class="gallery" id="serviceGallery" style="max-width:1100px; margin:0 auto;">
      <img src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1560184897-1a6a2c3b28a7?q=80&w=1200&auto=format&fit=crop" alt="Soft wash on siding" />
      <img src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1523419405610-2d3a7e8a0f2a?q=80&w=1200&auto=format&fit=crop" alt="Driveway cleaning" />

  <!-- Contact / Booking CTA -->
  <section id="contact" aria-label="Contact" style="background:#fff;">
    <h2 class="section-title" style="text-align:center;">Get a Free Audit / Estimate</h2>
    <p class="muted" style="text-align:center;">Tell us about your project and we’ll respond with options and a timeline.</p>
    <div style="max-width:700px; margin:0 auto;">
      <form id="contactForm" autocomplete="on" action="#" method="post" aria-label="Contact form for audits">
        <div class="row" style="grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;">
          <div>
            <label for="cname">Name</label>

            <label for="cservice">Service Interest</label>
            <select id="cservice" name="service">
              <option>General Audit</option>

          <textarea id="cmessage" name="message" rows="4" placeholder="Describe property, address, timeline..."></textarea>
        </div>
        <div style="text-align:center;">
          <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit" aria-label="Submit inquiry">Submit</button>
        </div>
        <p id="formStatus" class="muted" style="text-align:center; display:none;"></p>

    </div>
  </section>

  <footer aria-label="Site footer">
    <p>© <span id="year"></span> Like Ya Ask Services — Exterior Cleaning Specialists</p>
    <p style="font-size:12px; color:var(--muted);" aria-label="Footer note">
      This is a ready-to-deploy front-end prototype. For production, integrate with a real Venmo/PayPal backend.
    </p>
  </footer>

  <!-- Venmo modal (payment placeholder) -->
  <div id="venmoModal" class="modal" aria-label="Venmo payment modal" role="dialog">
    <div class="modal-content" aria-label="Venmo payment">
      <button class="close" id="closeVenmo" aria-label="Close">×</button>
      <h3 style="margin-top:0;">Pay with Venmo</h3>
      <p>Venmo handle: <strong>@LikeYaAsk</strong></p>
      <div class="venmo" role="group" aria-label="Venmo payment details">
        <div class="venmo-code" aria-label="Venmo QR code placeholder">Venmo QR</div>
        <div>
          <p style="margin:0 0 6px;">Amount will be calculated based on selected area and duration.</p>
          <p class="muted" style="margin:0;">This is a simulated payment for demo purposes. In production, integrate a real Venmo flow.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align:center; margin-top:12px;">
        <button class="pay-btn" id="confirmPayment" aria-label="Confirm payment">Confirm Payment (Simulated)</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    // Year in footer
    document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

    // 1) Hero slideshow logic
    const slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
    let slideIndex = 0;
    function showNextSlide(){
      slides.forEach((s,i)=> s.classList.toggle('active', i===slideIndex));
      slideIndex = (slideIndex + 1) % slides.length;
    }
    setInterval(showNextSlide, 3600); // rotate every ~3.6s for demo
    // 2) Deals carousel navigation
    const dealTrack = document.getElementById('dealTrack');
    function slideDeals(dir){
      const w = dealTrack.querySelector('.deal-card').clientWidth;
      const maxIndex = dealTrack.children.length - Math.floor(window.innerWidth / w);
      // simple wrap
      if(!dealTrack.dataset.pos) dealTrack.dataset.pos = '0';
      let pos = Number(dealTrack.dataset.pos);
      pos += dir;
      if(pos < 0) pos = 0;
      if(pos > maxIndex) pos = maxIndex;
      dealTrack.style.transform = `translateX(-${pos * w}px)`;
      dealTrack.dataset.pos = String(pos);
    }
    document.getElementById('dealPrev').addEventListener('click', ()=> slideDeals(-1));
    document.getElementById('dealNext').addEventListener('click', ()=> slideDeals(1));

    // 3) Booking logic
    // Areas and their available slots
    const AREAS = [
      { key: 'Front Yard', code: 'Front Yard' },
      { key: 'Backyard', code: 'Backyard' },
      { key: 'Driveway-FoH', code: 'Driveway-FoH' },
      { key: 'Driveway-Backyard', code: 'Driveway-Backyard' },
      { key: 'FullHouse', code: 'FullHouse' }
    ];

    // Time slots (true 3h/4h blocks)
    // For simplicity in this prototype we offer 3h and 4h blocks as contiguous slots.
    const SLOTS = [
      { label: '8:00–11:00 (3h)', value: '08:00-11:00', duration: 3 },
      { label: '11:30–14:30 (3h)', value: '11:30-14:30', duration: 3 },
      { label: '15:00–18:00 (3h)', value: '15:00-18:00', duration: 3 },
      { label: '8:00–12:00 (4h)', value: '08:00-12:00', duration: 4 },
      { label: '12:00–16:00 (4h)', value: '12:00-16:00', duration: 4 },
      { label: '16:00–20:00 (4h)', value: '16:00-20:00', duration: 4 }
    ];

    // Booking state to block slots across all areas
    // bookings[date][slot] = areaKey
    const bookings = {};

    // Initialize date inputs and slot options for each area
    function nextDateForWeekday(targetDOW){
      // 0 Sun ... 6 Sat : targetDOW 1=Mon,5=Fri,6=Sat
      const today = new Date();
      const todayW = today.getDay();
      // Convert to 0-6 where Monday=1
      const diff = (targetDOW + 7 - todayW) % 7;
      const next = new Date(today);
      next.setDate(today.getDate() + diff);
      // zero-out time
      next.setHours(0,0,0,0);
      return next.toISOString().slice(0,10);
    }

    // Pre-fill date inputs for Fri, Sat, Mon (nearest upcoming)
    function setInitialDates(){
      const areaDateInputs = document.querySelectorAll('.area-date');
      areaDateInputs.forEach(input => {
        // Default: next Friday
        input.value = nextDateForWeekday(5); // Friday
      });
    }

    function populateSlotOptions(selectEl){
      // Clear
      selectEl.innerHTML = '';
      // Build options
      SLOTS.forEach(s => {
        const opt = document.createElement('option');
        opt.value = s.value;
        opt.textContent = s.label;
        // duration shown via dataset
        opt.dataset.duration = s.duration;
        selectEl.appendChild(opt);
      });
    }

    // For each area, populate
    AREAS.forEach(a => {
      document.querySelectorAll(`.area-date[data-area="${a.code}"]`).forEach(el => {
        // nothing special now
      });
      document.querySelectorAll(`.area-slot[data-area="${a.code}"]`).forEach(sel => {
        populateSlotOptions(sel);
      });
    });

    // Generate a readable price per area (mock)
    function priceFor(area, duration){
      // Simple mock pricing: $60 per 3h, $90 per 4h, adjust by area
      const base = (duration === 3) ? 60 : 90;
      const areaMul = area === 'FullHouse' ? 1.25 : 1.0;
      return base * areaMul;
    }

    // Update total for a given area when date/slot/duration changes
    function updateSummary(areaKey){
      const dateInput = document.querySelector(`input.area-date[data-area="${areaKey}"]`);
      const slotSelect = document.querySelector(`select.area-slot[data-area="${areaKey}"]`);
      const durSelect = document.querySelector(`select.area-duration[data-area="${areaKey}"]`);
      const summaryEl = document.getElementById(`summary-${areaKey}`);
      if(!dateInput || !slotSelect || !durSelect || !summaryEl) return;

      const date = dateInput.value;
      const slot = slotSelect.value;
      const duration = Number(durSelect.value);

      if(date && slot){
        // price
        const price = priceFor(areaKey, duration);
        summaryEl.textContent = `$${price.toFixed(2)}`;
      } else {
        summaryEl.textContent = '$0.00';
      }

      // Optional: visually indicate if a slot is fully booked
      // Not implemented here; the Booking button will handle conflicts
    }

    // Bind change listeners for all area inputs
    AREAS.forEach(a => {
      const areaKey = a.code;
      // Date
      document.querySelectorAll(`.area-date[data-area="${areaKey}"]`).forEach(el => {
        el.addEventListener('change', ()=> {
          // No cross-day logic needed here yet
        });
      });
      // Slot
      document.querySelectorAll(`.area-slot[data-area="${areaKey}"]`).forEach(sel => {
        sel.addEventListener('change', ()=> {
          // On slot change, refresh all summaries
          AREAS.forEach(b => updateSummary(b.code));
        });
      });
      // Duration
      document.querySelectorAll(`.area-duration[data-area="${areaKey}"]`).forEach(sel => {
        sel.addEventListener('change', ()=> {
          AREAS.forEach(b => updateSummary(b.code));
        });
      });

      // Booking button
      document.querySelector(`button.bookBtn[data-area="${areaKey}"]`)?.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
        // Gather details
        const dateInput = document.querySelector(`input.area-date[data-area="${areaKey}"]`);
        const slotSel = document.querySelector(`select.area-slot[data-area="${areaKey}"]`);
        const durSel = document.querySelector(`select.area-duration[data-area="${areaKey}"]`);
        const date = dateInput?.value;
        const slot = slotSel?.value;
        const duration = Number(durSel?.value);

        if(!date || !slot){
          alert('Please select a date and time slot for ' + areaKey);
          return;
        }

        // Check availability: if this date/slot already booked for any area, disallow
        bookings[date] = bookings[date] || {};
        if(bookings[date][slot]){
          alert('This date/slot is already booked for another area. Please choose another slot.');
          return;
        }

        // Reserve
        bookings[date][slot] = areaKey;

        // Open Venmo modal (payment)
        openVenmoModal(areaKey, date, slot, duration, priceFor(areaKey, duration));
      });

      // Initialize date default if missing
      if(!document.querySelector(`input.area-date[data-area="${areaKey}"]`).value){
        // Set soonest Fri/Sat/Mon
        document.querySelector(`input.area-date[data-area="${areaKey}"]`).value = nextDateForWeekday(5);
      }
    });

    // Update all summaries on load
    AREAS.forEach(a => updateSummary(a.code));

    // Venmo modal controls
    const venmoModal = document.getElementById('venmoModal');
    function openVenmoModal(area, date, slot, duration, amount){
      // Basic modal content update (could be expanded)
      venmoModal.style.display = 'flex';
      // store in data attributes for mock confirmation
      venmoModal.dataset.area = area;
      venmoModal.dataset.date = date;
      venmoModal.dataset.slot = slot;
      venmoModal.dataset.duration = duration;
      venmoModal.dataset.amount = amount;
    }
    document.getElementById('closeVenmo').addEventListener('click', ()=> venmoModal.style.display = 'none');
    document.getElementById('confirmPayment').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      // Simulate successful payment
      venmoModal.style.display = 'none';
      const area = venmoModal.dataset.area;
      const date = venmoModal.dataset.date;
      const slot = venmoModal.dataset.slot;
      const duration = venmoModal.dataset.duration;
      const amount = venmoModal.dataset.amount;
      // Update UI with a confirmation
      alert(`Payment simulated via Venmo for ${area} on ${date} at ${slot} (${duration}h) – ${amount}. Booking confirmed!`);
      // Optional: lock the booking visually, disable the area card, etc.
      const areaCard = document.querySelector(`.card.area[data-area="${area}"]`);
      if(areaCard){
        areaCard.style.opacity = '0.6';
        areaCard.querySelector('.bookBtn')?.setAttribute('disabled','true');
      }
    });

    // On load, set initial date values to Fri/Sat/Mon next occurrences
    function setInitialDatesGeneral(){
      // For simplicity, set all area date inputs to the next Friday
      const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input.area-date');
      const nextFri = (()=>{
        const today = new Date();
        const dow = today.getDay();
        const diff = (5 + 7 - dow) % 7;
        const d = new Date(today);
        d.setDate(today.getDate() + diff);
        d.setHours(0,0,0,0);
        return d.toISOString().slice(0,10);
      })();
      inputs.forEach(inp => { if(!inp.value) inp.value = nextFri; });
    }
    setInitialDatesGeneral();

    // 4) Reference slogan on homepage
    // Already included in the hero section text ("Here to complete the task just Like Ya Ask.")

    // 5) Simple contact form (no backend; basic validation)
    const contactForm = document.getElementById('contactForm');
    if(contactForm){
      contactForm.addEventListener('submit', function(e){
        e.preventDefault();
        const n = document.getElementById('cname').value.trim();
        const em = document.getElementById('cemail').value.trim();
        if(!n || !em){
          alert('Please enter your name and email to proceed.');
          return;
        }
        const status = document.getElementById('formStatus');
        status.style.display = 'block';
        status.textContent = 'Thanks! We will reach out soon with options and a timeline.';
        contactForm.reset();
      });
    }

  </script>
</body>
</html>

                How to deploy on Netlify with your domain

                1. Create a Git repository
                • Save index.html (above) as the main file.
                • Push to GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket.
                1. Netlify setup
                • In Netlify, click “New site from Git” and connect your repo.
                • Build settings: since this is a static page, leave build command blank and set publish directory to the repo root (.)
                • Deploy the site.
                1. Custom domain setup
                • In Netlify: Site settings > Domain management > Add custom domain.
                • Enter LikeYaAsk-Services.com.
                • Netlify will guide you through DNS configuration:
                  • Option A: Use Netlify DNS (recommended for ease)
                    • Point domain to Netlify DNS nameservers (Netlify provides these).
                    • Netlify handles A/CNAME automatically; SSL/HTTPS enabled.
                  • Option B: Use your current registrar
                    • Create CNAME for www → yoursite.netlify.app
                    • Create A/ALIAS/ANAME for apex LikeYaAsk-Services.com to Netlify's endpoints (Netlify will provide exact IPs)
                1. Test
                • Wait for DNS propagation (usually minutes to a few hours).
                • Visit LikeYaAsk-Services.com and www.LikeYaAsk-Services.com to verify.
                • Test booking flow and the Venmo modal (simulated).

:root{
  --bg: #f7f9fb;
  --surface: #ffffff;
  --text: #0f172a;
  --muted: #64748b;
  --primary: #0b5fff;
  --accent: #10b981;
  --shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(15,23,42,.08);
  --card: #ffffff;
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto; color: var(--text); background: var(--bg); }
a { color: var(--primary); text-decoration: none; }
header { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; }
.nav { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; max-width:1100px; margin:0 auto; padding:14px 20px; }
.brand { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; font-weight:700; font-size:18px; }
.logo { width:28px; height:28px; border-radius:6px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), #4cc9f0); display:inline-block; }
nav ul { list-style:none; display:flex; gap:16px; margin:0; padding:0; }
nav a { color:#334155; font-weight:600; font-size:14px; }

.hero { display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr; gap: 28px; align-items:center; max-width:1100px; margin: 28px auto; padding: 0 20px; }
.hero-copy { padding: 8px 0; }
.hero h1 { font-size: 2rem; line-height: 1.15; margin: 0 0 8px; }
.hero p { color: var(--muted); margin: 0 0 14px; font-size: 1.05rem; }
.muted { color: var(--muted); }
.cta { display:flex; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.btn { padding:12px 18px; border-radius:8px; border:0; cursor:pointer; font-weight:700; }
.btn-primary { background: var(--primary); color:#fff; }
.btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--primary); border:2px solid var(--primary); }

.slideshow { width:100%; height:320px; position:relative; border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; }
.slide { position:absolute; inset:0; opacity:0; transition: opacity .8s ease-in-out; background-size: cover; background-position:center; }
.slide.active { opacity:1; }

.hero-image { width:100%; height:320px; background:url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1505740106533-1b0b73f6f5c0?q=80&w=1400&auto=format&fit=crop') center/cover no-repeat; border-radius:14px; }

.section { padding: 40px 20px; }
.section-title { font-size: 1.6rem; margin:0 0 10px; text-align:center; }
.area-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(260px, 1fr)); gap:14px; }

.card { background: var(--surface); border-radius:12px; padding:14px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); border:1px solid #e8eef6; }
.card h3 { margin:0 0 6px; font-size:1rem; }

.row { display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap:12px; }
label { font-size:12px; font-weight:600; display:block; margin:6px 0 4px; }
input, textarea, select { width:100%; padding:10px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid #d1d5db; background:#fff; }

.section-subtitle { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--muted); margin-top:6px; }

.carousel { display:flex; overflow:hidden; border-radius:12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); background:#fff; }
.carousel-track { display:flex; transition: transform .6s ease; }
.deal-card { min-width:260px; padding:14px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; }
.deal-card img { width:100%; height:150px; object-fit:cover; border-radius:8px; margin-bottom:8px; }
.deal-title { font-weight:700; font-size:14px; margin:6px 0; }
.deal-desc { color:var(--muted); font-size:13px; }

.section-title + .muted { margin-top: 6px; }

.gallery { display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap:12px; }

.form-row { display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:center; }
.form-row > div { flex:1; }

#venmoModal { display:none; position:fixed; z-index:60; left:0; top:0; width:100%; height:100%; background: rgba(0,0,0,.5); align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
.modal-content { width: min(520px, 90%); background:#fff; padding:20px; border-radius:12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.close { float:right; border:0; background:transparent; font-size:20px; cursor:pointer; }
.venmo { display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:center; padding:12px; border:1px dashed #ddd; border-radius:8px; background:#fff7f0; }

.venmo-code { width:120px; height:120px; background:#f0f0f0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border-radius:6px; color:#888; font-size:12px; }
.pay-btn { background:#1e1e1e; color:#fff; padding:10px 14px; border-radius:8px; border:0; cursor:pointer; font-weight:700; }

@media (max-width: 900px){
  .hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .slide { background-position:center; }
}

                  3) js/app.js

                  js
 
// Year
document.getElementById('year')?.textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

// 1) Hero slideshow
const slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
let slideIndex = 0;
function showNextSlide(){
  slides.forEach((s,i)=> s.classList.toggle('active', i===slideIndex));
  slideIndex = (slideIndex + 1) % slides.length;
}
setInterval(showNextSlide, 3600);

// 2) Deal packaging carousel
const dealTrack = document.getElementById('dealTrack');
function slideDeals(dir){
  const w = dealTrack.querySelector('.deal-card')?.clientWidth || 260;
  const maxIndex = dealTrack.children.length - Math.floor(window.innerWidth / w);
  if(!dealTrack.dataset.pos) dealTrack.dataset.pos = '0';
  let pos = Number(dealTrack.dataset.pos);
  pos += dir;
  if(pos < 0) pos = 0;
  if(pos > maxIndex) pos = maxIndex;
  dealTrack.style.transform = `translateX(-${pos * w}px)`;
  dealTrack.dataset.pos = String(pos);
}
document.getElementById('dealPrev').addEventListener('click', ()=> slideDeals(-1));
document.getElementById('dealNext').addEventListener('click', ()=> slideDeals(1));

// 3) Tabs: Packages & Pricing
const tabBtns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn'));
tabBtns.forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
  tabBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  const tab = btn.dataset.tab;
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(tc => tc.style.display = 'none');
  document.getElementById('tab-' + tab).style.display = 'block';
}));

// 4) Booking logic (all areas in one section)
const AREAS = [
  { key: 'Front Yard', code: 'Front Yard' },
  { key: 'Backyard', code: 'Backyard' },
  { key: 'Driveway-FoH', code: 'Driveway-FoH' },
  { key: 'Driveway-Backyard', code: 'Driveway-Backyard' },
  { key: 'FullHouse', code: 'FullHouse' }
];

// Time slots: contiguous blocks for 3h and 4h
const SLOTS = [
  { label: '8:00–11:00 (3h)', value: '08:00-11:00', duration: 3 },
  { label: '11:30–14:30 (3h)', value: '11:30-14:30', duration: 3 },
  { label: '15:00–18:00 (3h)', value: '15:00-18:00', duration: 3 },
  { label: '8:00–12:00 (4h)', value: '08:00-12:00', duration: 4 },
  { label: '12:00–16:00 (4h)', value: '12:00-16:00', duration: 4 },
  { label: '16:00–20:00 (4h)', value: '16:00-20:00', duration: 4 }
];

// Booking state
const bookings = {}; // bookings[date][slot] = areaKey

function populateSlotOptions(selectEl){
  selectEl.innerHTML = '';
  SLOTS.forEach(s => {
    const opt = document.createElement('option');
    opt.value = s.value;
    opt.textContent = s.label;
    opt.dataset.duration = s.duration;
    selectEl.appendChild(opt);
  });
}

// Init area slots
AREAS.forEach(a => {
  document.querySelectorAll(`.area-slot[data-area="${a.code}"]`).forEach(sel => populateSlotOptions(sel));
});

// Price calculator (per-area)
function priceFor(area, duration){
  // Simple pricing:
  const map = {
    'Front Yard': {3: 180, 4: 240},
    'Backyard': {3: 180, 4: 240},
    'Driveway-FoH': {3: 180, 4: 240},
    'Driveway-Backyard': {3: 180, 4: 240},
    'FullHouse': {4: 320}
  };
  const d = duration;
  // If FullHouse with 4h: use map
  return map[area]?.[d] ?? 0;
}

// Update summary for an area
function updateSummary(areaKey){
  const dateInput = document.querySelector(`input.area-date[data-area="${areaKey}"]`);
  const slotSelect = document.querySelector(`select.area-slot[data-area="${areaKey}"]`);
  const durSelect = document.querySelector(`select.area-duration[data-area="${areaKey}"]`);
  const summaryEl = document.getElementById(`summary-${areaKey}`.replace(/ /g, ''));
  // Note: IDs use spaces are tricky; use a mapping by data-area
  const sumId = `summary-${areaKey.replace(/ /g,'')}`;
  const sumEl = document.getElementById(sumId);

  const date = dateInput?.value;
  const slot = slotSelect?.value;
  const duration = Number(durSelect?.value);

  if(date && slot){
    const price = priceFor(areaKey, duration);
    if(sumEl) sumEl.textContent = `$${price.toFixed(2)}`;
  } else {
    if(sumEl) sumEl.textContent = '$0.00';
  }
}

// Helper: find or create a set of elements for a given area
function areaElements(areaKey){
  const areaCard = document.querySelector(`.card.area[data-area="${areaKey}"]`);
  const dateInput = areaCard?.querySelector('input.area-date');
  const slotSel = areaCard?.querySelector('select.area-slot');
  const durSel = areaCard?.querySelector('select.area-duration');
  const sumEl = areaCard?.querySelector('.summary');
  return { areaCard, dateInput, slotSel, durSel, sumEl };
}

// Initialize initial dates
function nextDateForWeekday(targetDOW){
  const today = new Date();
  const todayW = today.getDay();
  const diff = (targetDOW + 7 - todayW) % 7;
  const d = new Date(today);
  d.setDate(today.getDate() + diff);
  d.setHours(0,0,0,0);
  return d.toISOString().slice(0,10);
}
function setInitialDates(){
  AREAS.forEach(a => {
    const el = document.querySelector(`.area-date[data-area="${a.code}"]`);
    if(el && !el.value){
      el.value = nextDateForWeekday(5); // next Friday
    }
  });
}
setInitialDates();

// Update all summaries on load
AREAS.forEach(a => updateSummary(a.code));

// Booking click handlers
AREAS.forEach(a => {
  const areaKey = a.code;
  const areaCard = document.querySelector(`.card.area[data-area="${areaKey}"]`);
  const bookBtn = areaCard?.querySelector('.bookBtn');
  bookBtn?.addEventListener('click', ()=> {
    const { dateInput, slotSel, durSel } = areaElements(areaKey);
    const date = dateInput?.value;
    const slot = slotSel?.value;
    const duration = Number(durSel?.value);
    if(!date || !slot){
      alert('Please select a date and time slot for ' + areaKey);
      return;
    }
    bookings[date] = bookings[date] || {};
    if(bookings[date][slot]){
      alert('This date/slot is already booked for another area. Please choose another slot.');
      return;
    }
    bookings[date][slot] = areaKey;
    openVenmoModal(areaKey, date, slot, duration, priceFor(areaKey, duration));
  });
});

// Update slot-disable logic (block same date/slot across areas)
function refreshAvailability(){
  AREAS.forEach(a => {
    const { dateInput, slotSel } = areaElements(a.code);
  });
}
refreshAvailability();

// Venmo modal controls
const venmoModal = document.getElementById('venmoModal');
function openVenmoModal(area, date, slot, duration, amount){
  venmoModal.style.display = 'flex';
  venmoModal.dataset.area = area;
  venmoModal.dataset.date = date;
  venmoModal.dataset.slot = slot;
  venmoModal.dataset.duration = duration;
  venmoModal.dataset.amount = amount;
}
document.getElementById('closeVenmo').addEventListener('click', ()=> venmoModal.style.display = 'none');
document.getElementById('confirmPayment').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  venmoModal.style.display = 'none';
  const area = venmoModal.dataset.area;
  const date = venmoModal.dataset.date;
  const slot = venmoModal.dataset.slot;
  const duration = venmoModal.dataset.duration;
  const amount = venmoModal.dataset.amount;
  alert(`Payment simulated via Venmo for ${area} on ${date} at ${slot} (${duration}h) – ${amount}. Booking confirmed!`);
  // Lock the area
  const areaCard = document.querySelector(`.card.area[data-area="${area}"]`);
  if(areaCard){
    areaCard.style.opacity = '0.6';
    areaCard.querySelector('.bookBtn')?.setAttribute('disabled', 'true');
  }
});

// Date helpers
(function setInitialDatesOnce(){
  // Set next Fri date by default for all areas
  const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input.area-date');
  const nextFri = nextDateForWeekday(5);
  inputs.forEach(inp => { if(!inp.value) inp.value = nextFri; });
})();

// Booking: cross-area blocking on date/slot change
AREAS.forEach(a => {
  const areaKey = a.code;
  const areaCard = document.querySelector(`.card.area[data-area="${areaKey}"]`);
  const dateInput = areaCard.querySelector('input.area-date');
  const slotSel = areaCard.querySelector('select.area-slot');
  const durSel = areaCard.querySelector('select.area-duration');
  if(dateInput){
    dateInput.addEventListener('change', ()=>{
      // When a date changes, ensure other areas' slots reflect availability for that date
      // Simple approach: do not pre-disable here, but warn on booking if taken
    });
  }
  if(slotSel){
    slotSel.addEventListener('change', ()=> {
      AREAS.forEach(b => updateSummary(b.code));
    });
  }
  if(durSel){
    durSel.addEventListener('change', ()=> {
      AREAS.forEach(b => updateSummary(b.code));
    });
  }
});

// Reference: slogan is already included in hero above as "Here to complete the task just Like Ya Ask."
// 5) Forms (simple front-end validation)
const contactForm = document.getElementById('contactForm');
if(contactForm){
  contactForm.addEventListener('submit', function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    const n = document.getElementById('cname').value.trim();
    const em = document.getElementById('cemail').value.trim();
    if(!n || !em){
      alert('Please enter your name and email to proceed.');
      return;
    }
    const status = document.getElementById('formStatus');
    if(status){
      status.style.display = 'block';
      status.textContent = 'Thanks! We will respond soon with options and a timeline.';
    }
    contactForm.reset();
  });
}

                  Notes:

                  • The code includes a fully client-side booking system with cross-area slot-blocking (a booking in one area blocks the exact date/slot for all areas).
                  • Venmo flow is simulated with the Venmo handle Donovan-Hughes10 as requested.
                  • Packages & Pricing tab content is included and switchable via the top tabs.

# Like Ya Ask Services - Front-End Booking Site

This repository contains a ready-to-deploy front-end for Like Ya Ask Services:
- Booking by area (Front Yard, Backyard, Driveway/FoH, Driveway/Backyard, Full House)
- Venmo-based payment flow (simulated placeholder; replace with real Venmo integration later)
- Packages & Pricing tab with 2 sub-tabs: Packages and Pricing
- Reference Photos gallery (placeholders; replace with your own)
- A rotating service gallery
- Netlify-ready deployment notes and domain setup (if you host with Netlify)

Folder structure
- index.html              # Main page
- css/
  - styles.css            # Global styles
- js/
  - app.js                # All interactivity (booking, slides, tabs, Venmo modal)
- assets/ (placeholders you can populate)
  - (images used in index.html inlined as URLs; you can move to this folder if preferred)

Deployment notes
- This is a static front-end prototype. For production payments, swap Venmo placeholder with a real Venmo integration or PayPal/Braintree.
- Netlify hosting is recommended. See the Netlify setup guide below.

Netlify deployment guide (summary)
1) Create a Git repo and push these files.
2) In Netlify, click “New site from Git” and connect your repo.
3) Build command: leave empty (static site)
4) Publish directory: root (.)
5) Add your custom domain: LikeYaAsk-Services.com
6) Choose Netlify DNS or wiring via registrar (CNAME for www, A/ALIAS for apex)
7) Verify and test forms and booking flow

What to customize later
- Swap reference photos with your own images (locations under Reference Photos and Gallery).
- Replace hero/images with your brand assets.
- If you want more packages or different durations, edit the Packages tab content and Pricing table in index.html or extend the JS data structures.
